title: Equality of NP and coNP under P equals NP
statement: If the class of polynomial-time decidable languages over the binary alphabet equals the class of languages with polynomial-length certificates verifiable in polynomial time, then that certificate class equals the class of languages whose complements have polynomial-length certificates verifiable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: The class of polynomial-time decidable binary languages equals the class of binary languages with polynomial-length certificates verifiable in polynomial time.
replaced:
If the class $\mathsf{P}$ of polynomial-time decidable binary languages equals
$\mathsf{NP}$, then $\mathsf{NP}$ equals coNP, where coNP is the class
of languages $L \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ whose complement $\{0,1\}^{*} \setminus L$ is
in $\mathsf{NP}$.
